meta.description: Country goals (GDD section 13): every country gets 3-5 goals chosen from these templates by its situation. Turns are weeks. Game-design defaults to be tuned in Phase 13. Master plan phase 6: the player also gets a short-term (buildings), a medium-term (technology) and a long-term objective (world power rank); finished player goals give a reward by term: national support, better relations with allies and friendly countries (relation at least friendRelation), technology points and diplomatic points.
